preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 2^16, inclusive.
The degree of each vertex is between 0 and n - 1, inclusive.
The XOR sum of adjacent vertices for each vertex is between 0 and 2^16 - 1, exclusive.

preconditions.expression: There exists a forest that corresponds to the numbers written by Misha.
preconditions.description: The input data guarantees that there exists a forest that can be reconstructed from the given degrees and XOR sums.

postconditions.description: The number of edges printed is equal to the number of edges in the initial graph.

postconditions.expression: all((0 <= a < n and 0 <= b < n and a != b) for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge is between two distinct vertices within the range of 0 to n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all((degree[a] ^ degree[b]) == s_i for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: The XOR sum of the vertices connected by each edge matches the given XOR sum.
The graph formed by the edges is acyclic.
The graph formed by the edges is connected.
